text:
nora: Quick check-in after last night's dispatch. We need concrete owners for the postmortem actions and a short SLO amendment plan.

ben: agreed. short summary: sustained p95 regressions on /v1/respond during peak windows, repeated every 4-6h. Error budget consumed ~45% in 10h on that route.

kevin: I traced a pattern to connection churn between frontend router and the pool — tail latency amplification under bursty fanout. Recorded traces in INF-910.

nora: action proposals in INF-910: (A) route-level alerting + per-route dashboard, (B) short-term SLO softening for that route, (C) connection pool tuning and circuit-breaker thresholds, (D) automated smoke replay. Need owners for A-D and timelines.

tina: I'll take A (dashboards/alerts). ETA Tue noon. Will include p50/p95/p99 and request-level histograms.

ben: I'll own C (pool & CB tuning). Plan: reduce max-inflight per connection, increase keepalive window, and add jitter to backoff. Experimenting now, aim Fri EOD.

kevin: I'll handle D (smoke replay and trace collection). Will coordinate with infra for golden traffic. Target Thu.

nora: B is SLO talk: propose temporary p95 target change from 160ms -> 240ms for /v1/respond for 72h with monitoring and customer comms. Opinions?

ben: prefer 48h if possible, but support 72h if we need more time to validate fixes. Also recommend enabling stricter anomaly alerts while SLO is relaxed.

tina: +1 to stricter alerts; I'll create a high-sensitivity channel alert to catch regressions while the SLO window is open.

ops-bot: draft status update created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INF-910-slo-draft — react with :eyes: to comment, :white_check_mark: to approve.

kevin: approved. I'll paste replay plan in INF-910 and tag infra.

nora: put owners in the ticket: dashboards=tina, pool-tuning=ben, replay=kevin, comms=nora. Set milestone: dashboards Tue noon, replay Thu, tuning Fri EOD, status update live now if comms approved.

ben: adding a recurring cadence: add a weekly check for connection churn metrics and a rotating owner. I'll add to runbook.

tina: runbook link added to INF-910 with rotation schedule. Also wiring the dashboard to the runbook so on-call sees it.

nora: thanks. Last item: please capture a short retro note (2-3 bullets) for the monthly SLO review doc so we can consider longer-term SLA remediation.

kevin: will drop replay findings there.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting Mon 09:00 PT.

nora: great work team. check-in Mon 09:00 PT. Thanks :sparkles:
